items.t: "Drivetrain Malfunction" message from a failed charging unit
items.job: Replace combined charging unit (CCU), then program and code the car
items.note: BMW SIB 61 13 24 allows 30–39 flat-rate units including programming (BMW units are tenths of an hour). The iX uses CCU 61 44 5A73E28; the parts price shown is for the i4 version (61 44 5A73E23, about $2,368–$3,099), so the iX part may cost somewhat differently. Usually done under BMW warranty or a BMW campaign, so ask a dealer first.

items.t: Whine or grinding from the front electric motor
items.job: Diagnose front drive unit noise
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix depends on what the dealer finds. Under BMW SIB 12 04 22 the whole front drive unit is replaced; the unit alone sells for about $4,488–$5,445 plus a core charge, and this is normally a warranty job. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Reduced steering assist warning at start-up
items.job: Diagnose steering warning
items.note: Diagnosis only; BMW bulletins cover this, often with a software update. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Coolant leak under the vehicle and weak cabin heat
items.job: Find and repair coolant leak, then flush and bleed cooling system
items.note: Covers the cooling system flush and bleed only. The leaking part is usually replaced under warranty on newer vehicles; out of warranty, parts are extra.
